A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] was a [[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenary]] working for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. On [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], he and group of other Mandalorians were hired to take down the [[Carth Onasi]] monument in [[Axial Park]], killing several [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officers in the process.

He was later seen boasting his completed mission with his fellow Mandalorian mercenaries at the nearby Imperial base, saying the rounds were on him.
